description: This source file implements a program to create CRC checksums and encode files, primarily for firmware or data integrity purposes. It reads a file, computes a CRC, encodes the data, and writes the encoded data to a new file.

methods.name: make_crc16
methods.description: Calculates a CRC16 checksum using the CCITT polynomial with MSB first.

methods.name: readfile
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into memory and returns a pointer to the buffer.
